item.title: 17th Annual Capital City Senior Games return to Tallahassee next week
item.description: 800 athletes from over 50 cities are expected to compete in the Capital City Senior Games starting Feb. 25. It features track, swimming, and pickleball events and welcomes all skill levels.

item.title: Data center debate divides Lowndes County neighbors after town hall
item.description: A proposed 720-acre data center near Foxborough has divided the community. Residents say they're concerned how the development will impact water, the environment, and utility costs.

item.title: Tallahassee faith communities begin Lent and Ramadan on same day in rare spiritual alignment
item.description: A rare spiritual moment in Tallahassee as Christians begin Lent and Muslims start Ramadan on the same day. Local faith communities are embracing prayer, fasting, and renewal during this time.
